title: linecite snapshot chunks.jsonl row v0 (UNSTABLE)
description: Written from docs/design/snapshot-contract.md §2.1/§4/§5 (not from code). Wire form: one canonical JSON object per line (UTF-8, code-point-sorted keys, compact separators, \n-terminated), rows sorted by chunk_uid; EXACTLY this key set — unknown or missing keys reject. NOT schema-enforceable (importers MUST check separately, §2.1/§4/§8): per-line canonical-byte equality; end_line >= start_line; recomputation of content_sha/chunk_id/chunk_uid per the §4 formulas; file-wide chunk_uid ordering; chunk_uid and (source_path, chunk_ordinal) uniqueness; host/origin_repo equality with the manifest.

source_path.description: canonical POSIX relative path: no leading/trailing '/', single-'/' separated non-empty segments, no '.'/'..' segments, no backslash or NUL; byte comparison, no unicode normalization
